explanation.fa: The kitchen was renovated روی آشپزخانه و کاری که روی آن انجام شده تمرکز دارد؛ شخص بازسازی‌کننده نام برده نشده است. was + renovated با last year زمان گذشته را نشان می‌دهد. with فر و یخچال نو را به توصیف اضافه می‌کند.
explanation.en: The kitchen was renovated focuses on the kitchen and what happened to it, not on who did the work. Was + renovated with last year places the change in the past. With adds the new appliances.

example.text: The kitchen was renovated last year, with a new oven and fridge.

translation.fa: آشپزخانه سال گذشته با یک فر و یخچال نو بازسازی شد.
translation.en: The kitchen was renovated last year, with a new oven and fridge.

takeaway.fa: برای کار انجام‌شده روی آشپزخانه: was renovated.
takeaway.en: For work done to the kitchen: was renovated.

rows.text: The kitchen was renovated last year
with a new oven and fridge

explanation.fa: How is the kitchen? دربارهٔ وضعیت آشپزخانه می‌پرسد. What about the bedrooms? موضوع بعدی را مطرح می‌کند. bright یعنی پرنور و spacious یعنی جادار؛ این دو یکی نیستند.
explanation.en: How is the kitchen? asks about its condition. What about the bedrooms? moves to another feature. Bright describes light; spacious describes available space.

example.text: It is bright and spacious, how is the kitchen?

translation.fa: روشن و جادار است؛ آشپزخانه چطور است؟
translation.en: It is bright and spacious, how is the kitchen?

takeaway.fa: برای بخش بعدی خانه بپرس What about ...?
takeaway.en: Ask What about ...? to move to the next home feature.

rows.en: Light and space are separate qualities

explanation.fa: faces فعل است: اتاق رو به خیابان است. so نتیجه را می‌گوید. در quite quiet، quite یعنی نسبتاً و quiet یعنی ساکت؛ شباهت املایی نباید معنی‌ها را یکی کند. inner street عین تعبیر منبع است و خیابان داخلی را می‌گوید، نه الزاماً حیاط.
explanation.en: Faces is a verb: the room looks toward a street. So introduces a result. In quite quiet, quite means fairly, while quiet means not noisy. Inner street is the source wording; it does not explicitly say courtyard.

example.text: The main bedroom faces the inner street, so it is quite quiet.

translation.fa: اتاق‌خواب اصلی رو به خیابان داخلی است، پس نسبتاً ساکت است.
translation.en: The main bedroom faces the inner street, so it is quite quiet.

takeaway.fa: quite شدت را می‌گوید؛ quiet کم‌سروصداست.
takeaway.en: Quite gives degree; quiet describes little noise.

rows.en: A result with two different words

explanation.fa: inclusive of water and electricity یعنی شامل آب و برق. or دو حالت را برای سؤال می‌گذارد. پاسخ They are separate به هزینهٔ آب و برق برمی‌گردد؛ کم بودن building fees به معنی رایگان بودن آن‌ها نیست.
explanation.en: Inclusive of water and electricity means those costs are included. Or presents two alternatives. They are separate refers to the water and electricity costs; low building fees does not mean those utilities are free.

example.text: Is the rent inclusive of water and electricity, or do I pay them separately?

translation.fa: اجاره شامل آب و برق هم هست یا باید آن‌ها را جداگانه بپردازم؟
translation.en: Is the rent inclusive of water and electricity, or do I pay them separately?

takeaway.fa: inclusive of یعنی شامل؛ separately یعنی جداگانه.
takeaway.en: Inclusive of means including; separately means as a separate payment.

rows.en: Asks about the scope of rent

title.en: A polite wish and an intention

explanation.fa: I would like to see خواستهٔ مؤدبانه است. I think I am going to take it تصمیمی در حال شکل‌گیری را می‌گوید: take it در بازدید یعنی انتخاب کردن برای اجاره، نه برداشتن یک شیء. امضای قرارداد هنوز گزارش نشده است.
explanation.en: I would like to see is a polite wish. I think I am going to take it signals an emerging intention: take it here means choose the apartment to rent, not pick up an object. No signed contract is reported.

example.text: It is a great place, I think I am going to take it.

translation.fa: جای خیلی خوبی است؛ فکر می‌کنم می‌خواهم اجاره‌اش کنم.
translation.en: It is a great place, I think I am going to take it.

takeaway.fa: would like to برای خواسته؛ going to برای قصد آینده.
takeaway.en: Use would like to for a wish and going to for an intention.
